description: Core20 restricted exactly to Extended30 timestamps and split indices by experiments.build_common_date_dataset. Reviewer must replace SHA256_AFTER_BUILD with manifest output_sha256 before prepare. Full validation-only LR search; three final seeds. HimNet uses the pinned adapter.
evaluation: test forecasts clipped at zero vehicles for every model; MAE, RMSE and WMAPE per horizon step

excluded_models.d2stgnn: about 0.2 s per batch and 23 GB with 240-360 movement nodes; excluded before any result for computational cost

graph: movement-level corridor graph (experiments/movement_graph.py); graph baselines receive the same graph
loss: mean absolute error on vehicle counts (inverse training scaling)
split: Exact Extended30 dates and chronological train_end/val_end; recomputed Core20 training-only channel scaling
